dwarfkit commit: 2d158891fd4159cedee37c12d31623e82224c4c7
Local patches: cmake/CompilerWarnings.cmake adds -Wno-missing-field-initializers for GNU (GCC 14+ designated-initializer false positives with -Werror).
Also suppresses GCC-only -Warray-bounds/-Wstringop-overflow/-Wstringop-overread false positives (GCC bugs 96963/105562 family) in cmake/CompilerWarnings.cmake.

-Wno-format-truncation added to the same GCC block: GCC 13 (ubuntu CI)
flags a snprintf in antelope/chain/time.cpp that GCC 16 accepts; the
buffer is provably large enough for any real time_point.
